# Tool — Creative Consultancy
> Brand identity, web design, and web development. New York.

## About
Tool is a creative consultancy specializing in brand identity design, web design, and web development for businesses. Based in New York, working with clients globally.

## Services

### Brand Identity Design
Logo design, visual systems, typography, color palettes, and brand guidelines. Creating distinctive brand identities for businesses ready to stand out.

### Web Design
Responsive website design from concept to launch. User experience design, visual design, prototyping in Figma, and production-ready implementation.

### Web Development
Custom web development and web applications using modern frameworks (Astro, React), serverless backends (Supabase), and scalable hosting platforms (Cloudflare Pages).

## Key Facts
- Location: New York, NY
- Industries: Technology, Creative, B2B Services, Startups
- Approach: Direct, collaborative, technical. One person, not an agency.
- Contact: hugetool@proton.me
- Booking: https://tool.nyc/book
- Portfolio: https://tool.nyc/#work

## Process
Projects typically range from brand refreshes to full web applications. We work directly with founders and business leaders, focusing on strategic creative consulting and technical implementation.

## Technologies
- Frontend: Astro, React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS
- Backend: Supabase (Postgres), Cloudflare Workers
- Hosting: Cloudflare Pages, Cloudflare R2, Cloudflare Stream
- Tools: Figma, GSAP, Stripe, Resend, Cal.com

Portfolio highlights available at tool.nyc — view case studies for brand identity and web design projects.
